The crest beside the version line is gone.

## 🎨 Design

- **The crest on the About card is removed.** It was an easter egg: a small coat of arms that turned when you pressed and held it, with the seven characters of this build's revision on its back. Gone with everything it touched, including its entry in the easter-egg list.
- **The revision is no longer drawn anywhere in the interface.** It still reaches the browser and `/api/health` still answers with it, but the back of that crest was the only place it was ever shown. Worth knowing if you run a `preview` build, where the version line says the same thing in every build and the revision is what tells two of them apart.
